conclusion: All 9914 retained source/URL contexts need successful transport within 30h for strict full-source success; they do not all need new model work. The regular scheduled selection cannot keep any of the 17 full inventories fresh, and even ideal raw sharing cannot sustain all 17 within the 5500/day fetch cap.
ownerDecisionBoundary: No new permission is needed to continue accepted repairs or honestly degraded collection. A change in what whole-source success means needs an explicit owner policy decision; this audit changes no meaning, scope, 557 denominator or allowance.

limits.interpretation: maxDocumentsPerSource and maxAuditDocumentsPerSource are selection bounds per invocation, not a separate persistent per-source daily ledger. Daily model/document/fetch ledgers are persistent. More forced invocations are technically possible but do not prove an authorized regular operating solution or change sustained fetch arithmetic.

sharedGroups.authority: Exact overlap of independently reconstructed full inventories; no subject or semantic proof shared.

transport.currentOrdinarySharingRule: same invocation, exact URL + sorted allowedHosts + supplierId; full HTTP 200 only. Cross-supplier reuse is currently restricted to strict data.sec.gov sources.
transport.oneOffBoundary: Two UTC-day allowances can theoretically contain enough raw requests inside one 30h window after semantic proof exists. This does not prove achievable completion with selection, extraction, index, runtime and other task constraints; it cannot sustain the required average rate.

semanticAndArchivedTransport.semanticBudgetCannotBeDerivedExactlyFrom: Every URL needs a valid document disposition, but unchanged exact-context caches and valid shared-publisher no-entity exclusions require zero new model/document reservations. Unfetched/changed inputs cannot be assumed cacheable, irrelevant or distinct.

implementationOnlyOptions.benefit: Recover exact current-policy proof without repeating models while the original transport is fresh.
implementationOnlyOptions.limit: Only 24 chains are currently replayable in the pinned audit; all retain original dates and expire. None of the 17 tasks completes from rebinding alone.

implementationOnlyOptions.option: Conditional GET and exact semantic cache reuse
implementationOnlyOptions.benefit: 3,530 of 4,543 latest archived raw checks have an ETag or Last-Modified hint. A genuine successful conditional request can establish new transport and unchanged exact input can reuse semantic proof.
implementationOnlyOptions.limit: Each actual request is charged; server support/unchanged bytes are not promised. A 304 does not remove the 30h request-rate requirement, copy provenance between suppliers, or renew old observation/review dates.

implementationOnlyOptions.benefit: A narrowly reviewed implementation with identical exact URL/host/redirect/header policy and separate source observations/semantic validation could remove the 638 duplicated Thoma Bravo article GETs, following the existing strict SEC sharing principle.
implementationOnlyOptions.limit: Even the optimistic shared bound remains 7,420.8 article requests/day. Do not share 304 chains, failures, supplier dispositions, broader redirect policies or old fetchedAt.

implementationOnlyOptions.benefit: Full readable primary text with no correctly registered entity mention may resolve investor_acquirer/release_distribution documents without models. Ten such current-policy validations already exist among the 24.
implementationOnlyOptions.limit: The 4,532 shared-publisher source/URL contexts still need fresh transport and exact per-target validation. URL/title absence is insufficient. The current malformed Sophos alias must be corrected through proper reviewed data/policy handling before trusting broad Sophos exclusions.

implementationOnlyOptions.benefit: Actual bounded first-party indexes, dated entries and literal pagination can improve future discovery and scheduling without increasing caps.
implementationOnlyOptions.limit: No reviewed evidence here grants an ordinary-site immutable-history exception. A newer index visit/lastmod/old boundary cannot renew retained article transport, drop known inventory, or silently make a new complete/quiet source claim.

decisionSurfaceCritique.assessment: The proposal identifies a genuine meaning-of-success choice only if the owner wants continuously successful whole-source checks while all 9914 ordinary documents retain the 30h rule. Existing code repairs and honest degraded operation remain authorized without this choice.
retainBoundaries: Keep intake success, completed current fact processing and historical audit completion separate.
A fresh complete index is not a complete current-event recall or semantic-review result.
Retain old source/effective/review dates, complete URL inventory, policy provenance and measured baseline; no automatic claim or financial-certification refresh.
recommendedTightenings: Support the decision with the hard sustained-fetch lower bound, not only the per-invocation two-selected operational bound.

Replace the unconditional consequence that separate daily monitoring can work within the existing allowance with a requirement to measure actual intake volume, new/changed/undated work, continuation completeness and semantic cost. Feasibility of a newly defined daily metric is not proved by this inventory audit.

Ensure intake-only success cannot enter a metric named complete current-event coverage, or mark unreviewed current documents quiet/old. Required current processing and unknown-date work must stay explicit.

Present an owner decision only for changing what a successful source check establishes. Conditional fetch, exact cache/rebinding repairs, legitimate source qualification and correct entity screening already fit the authorized strict work.

strongestCaseAgainstConclusion.case: The two-selected bound alone is not an impossibility theorem: forced invocations are possible, zero-model cache/exclusion work can exceed the new-model document count, and two UTC-day fetch allowances can permit a one-off fresh window. A genuinely qualified source scope/boundary may reduce future work.
strongestCaseAgainstConclusion.whySustainedBoundStillHolds: The 9276 unique leaf URL lower bound already grants perfect safe sharing and zero new model work, omits index and other task overhead, and still requires 7420.8 charged requests/day on average. No retained ordinary-site proof permits skipping these real requests while keeping the current 30h full-history rule.
strongestCaseAgainstConclusion.wouldChangeConclusion: Actual primary evidence and a properly reviewed qualification/policy interpretation that preserves every obligation while proving fewer required fresh leaf checks; or an explicit owner change to the success/freshness definition. Neither is established by the inspected archive.
